verdict.rationale: The evidence documents versioning, review, and rollback for site deploys: auto-deploy on push, Deploy Previews for every PR, and one-click deploy rollback. None of it is about automations or workflow definitions. Nothing shows that serverless functions or other automations are versioned, reviewed, or rolled back as their own unit, so deploy-level rollback is an adjacent feature rather than this story's capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
